### 1. Request, authorisation, simulator behaviour
- Caller: Tyler Brekke. He asks to "advance as much as the line will give me today into your checking account; up to thirty thousand dollars … will take whatever the line allows if it is less".
- Identification: phone 3084610815 → customer b73ec93d-…, member_number CPF-1647219, tax_id_last4 1093. `verify_member_identity` uses phone + member number (+ SSN last four if a third detail is asked).
- The simulator is passive and conditional:
  - It talks about the bounced AutoDraft only "If the representative brings up AutoDraft".
  - It agrees to re-enrol on account 4417 "if they say it has to be set up again".
  - It runs the handed-over AutoDraft set-up exactly as told.
  - It accepts a late charge.
  - It accepts a smaller advance.
- KB on ownership. The AutoDraft enrolment is member-owned: "This is the member's own tool … the customer themselves runs it". The late charge and the advance are agent tools.

### 2. Act now, wait or refuse
Act now. Visible grounds:
- The line is `status 'active'`, and the advance cutoff 2027-02-28 is after today ("Conditions of Advance" 1 and 2).
- Effective date. The request is received at 10:05 Central on a business day, before the StartRight 14:00 cutoff, so it takes effect today.
- Size and channel. The smallest StartRight advance is 250. The phone daily limit is 10,000, and no phone advance has been booked today.
- No freeze. The latest bill is 16 days past due, below the 30 StartRight freeze days, and `suspended_reason 'none'`.
- No borrowing base certificate is needed: "on a product that requires none, no certificate enters the advance".
- Two prior writes must come first (item 6). They are within the agent's and member's power on the call.

### 3. Business object and correlation keys
- Line 1a59afdb-5634-4574-8a68-ddcbeafda7a2, `StartRight Operating Line`, commitment 150,000. Opened 2020-03-02, last_renewed 2026-03-01, crop_year 2026. Rate on the line 7.22. `autodraft_enrolled False`, account_last4 ''.
- Latest interest bill: 07e53105-59de-4ff5-bda1-1b32fa272400, period 2026-01-01..2026-02-28, billed 813.44, due 2026-03-15. Against it:
  - an AutoDraft payment dd775865 of 813.44 on 03-15, returned (`operating_interest_payment_return` b3180c8d, return_reason `nsf`);
  - a phone payment of 300 on 03-20.
  - Unpaid: 513.44. No late charge points to it.
- Older bills are all paid; they are excluded by "the line's interest bill with the latest due date".
- Returned AutoDraft payments: 2025-07-15 (nsf) and 2026-03-15 (nsf). Both fall in the rolling 12 months ending 2026-03-15, so returned-payment rule 4 cancels AutoDraft on 2026-03-15. That is consistent with the line showing it not enrolled.
- Earlier late charge: 22b48eec, 49.22, on 2025-01-31.
- Records from other products:
  - FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage, active, principal_balance 120,000, accrued_interest 0, no farmland transactions (no billed interest unpaid), autopay False.
  - Country Home 30-Year Fixed, active, autopay False.
  - Used Equipment Loan, `deferred`, deferrals_used 1, autopay True.
  - Class B Voting Stock, active, issued 2019-02-05.
  - Crop Insurance `Revenue Protection 70% Coverage`, active, crop_year 2026, assigned to this line, beginning_farmer True.

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Late charge on bill 07e53105.** Baseline from "Late Charge Amount Schedule": charge base = billed − applied payments + returned AutoDraft debit = 813.44 − 1,113.44 + 813.44 = 513.44. Then 513.44 × 5% = 25.672 → 25.67, within the 25–250 bounds. Fall-back **25.67**.

Factors found from the records:
- Base after a returned debit. "Late Charge Base … AutoDraft Debit Came Back Unpaid": returned `nsf` is "a reason other than unauthorized", so the base is the full billed amount, 813.44.
- History. "Late Charge Percentage After Earlier Late Charges": exactly one late charge (2025-01-31) in the 24 whole months before today, so 6%.
- Farmland standing. "Late Charge Share for Members in Good Standing on Farm Real Estate Loans": an active FRE loan with no billed interest unpaid, so 0.75.
- Line tenure. "Length of Relationship…": first booked 2020-03-02 is 72 whole months before today, so 0.8.

Arithmetic: 813.44 × 6% × 0.75 × 0.8 = 29.28384 → **29.28** (above the 25 minimum, below the 250 maximum). Timing: grace is 15 days and the due date 2026-03-15 is day 0, so the last grace day is 03-30 and the charge first arises today, 03-31.

**(b) Contract rate at AutoDraft enrolment (today).** Baseline from "Rate Committee Statement — Contract Rate on the AutoDraft Enrolment Day":
- Base rate on 2026-03-31 = 7.250 (the 2025-12-11 entry). Plus the 0.65 spread = 7.900.
- Baseline discounts: program 1.0 + AutoDraft 0.125 + relationship 0.10 (FRE active) = 1.225, capped at 1.125.
- Fall-back rate **6.775**.

Factors found from the records:
- Program taper. "…Program Discount Over the Life of the Line": first booked 72 whole months ago (> 60), and the crop-year policy shows beginning_farmer True, so 0.5 × 1.0 = 0.5.
- AutoDraft discount. "AutoDraft Discount and the Line's Payment Record": counting the late charge assessed today in step (a), one or more late charges fall in the twelve whole months before the enrolment day, so 0.25 × 0.125 = 0.03125.
- Relationship scaling. "Relationship Discount Scaled to Farm Real Estate Borrowing": balance 120,000 < commitment 150,000, so 0.10 × 120,000 / 150,000 = 0.080.
- Country Home. "Country Home Relationship Discount": active, not on autopay, so 0.025.
- Equipment. "Equipment Relationship Discount": deferred and on autopay, so 0.05.
- Membership tenure. "Membership Tenure Discount": Class B issued 85 whole months before, so 0.025.

Total = 0.71125, under the 1.125 cap. Rate 7.900 − 0.71125 = 7.18875 → **7.189** (half up), above the 5.25 floor. Enrolment arguments: line_id 1a59afdb-…, account_last4 4417, interest_rate 7.189.

Residual visible-surface uncertainty, recorded honestly: the corpus never says outright whether a late charge dated today falls "in the twelve whole months before the enrolment day". If it is not counted, the tier is "no late charge, two or more returned payments" = 0.0625, the rate is 7.158 and the advance is 6,928.04. I chose the inclusive reading. Otherwise S2 below (the enrolment rate waits on the late charge) would have no effect on the records, and the corpus treats "within one whole month before today" as running up to the present ("payment returned last week").

**(c) Advance (as much as the line allows).** Baseline from "Available Credit and the Largest Phone Advance": available = 150,000 − 101,500 = 48,500, held to the room left on the phone limit (10,000). Fall-back **10,000.00**.

Factors found from the records:
- Crop cover. "Crop Insurance Cover and the Lending Limit": an assigned crop-year policy at 70% (at least the 70% minimum, below 80%), so the lending limit is taken at 0.95.
- Early season. "Early-Season Share of the Lending Limit on … Program Products": 0 whole months since the 2026-03-01 renewal, so 0.85.
- Past-due interest. "Past-Due Interest Reserve": billed interest unpaid 513.44 (billed 7,806.60 + returned 2,587.21 − payments 9,880.37). The latest bill is 16 days past due, more than 15 grace days, so all 513.44 is reserved.
- Returned-payment interest. "Interest Reserve … with Returned Payments": two returned payments in the twelve whole months, so 101,500 × 7.189% (the rate recorded on the line after enrolment) × 90 / 365 = 1,799.2196 → 1,799.22.
- Returned-payment hold. "Advance Hold Following a Recent Returned Payment": one returned within one whole month and two in twelve months, so 0.5.
- Equipment deferral. "Equipment Deferrals and the Share…": a deferred equipment loan with 1 deferral used, so 0.8.

Arithmetic: 150,000 × 0.95 × 0.85 = 121,125.00. Less 101,500, 513.44 and 1,799.22 = 17,312.34. Times 0.5 × 0.8 = 6,924.936, below the 10,000 phone room. Rounded: **6,924.94**.

### 5. Executable sequence
1. find_customers → verify_member_identity.
2. find_operating_lines / transactions. Also find_farmland_loans, find_homeloan_loans, find_equipment_loans, find_equity_accounts, find_cropins_policies.
3. (agent) unlock + call `assess_late_charge_706782fd`(line_id 1a59afdb-…, source_txn_id 07e53105-…, amount 29.28).
4. (agent) `unlock_user_discoverable_tool('enroll_autodraft_36bd3fb2')` and tell the member line_id 1a59afdb-…, account_last4 4417, interest_rate 7.189. (user) The member runs it, and the receipt shows status "enrolled".
5. (agent) unlock + call `book_operating_advance_f71c3718`(line_id 1a59afdb-…, amount 6924.94).

Terminal state: late charge 29.28 against 07e53105 (fees_due 59.28); AutoDraft enrolled on 4417 at 7.189 from today; one phone advance of 6,924.94 deposited to checking (principal 108,424.94).

### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials alone
- Root P0, the full available advance (an agent write). Its hub "Advancing the Full Available Credit on Operating Lines of Credit" states S1: "On a line whose AutoDraft was cancelled after returned payments, the amount of an advance is not fixed until the line's records show AutoDraft enrolled again."
- Hop P0 ← P1 (AutoDraft enrolment, the member's write). **State-derived.**
  - S1 names a state: the line's records show AutoDraft enrolled.
  - Records: the line shows `autodraft_enrolled False`. Two returned AutoDraft payments fall in the rolling window, so the "Returned Payments … AutoDraft Cancellation" rule 4 applies ("AutoDraft is cancelled the day the second return is booked"). The state does not hold.
  - Searching "AutoDraft enrolled" finds "AutoDraft Enrolment and the Enrolment-Day Contract Rate": "The line then shows AutoDraft enrolled, the last four digits of the debited account and the contract rate set on the enrolment day". That is the write that brings the state about, and it is the member's own tool.
- Hop P1 ← P2 (late charge on the latest bill, an agent write). **State-derived.**
  - P1's hub states S2: "The contract rate set when AutoDraft is enrolled is fixed only after the records carry a late charge on the line's latest interest bill whenever that bill is still unpaid after its grace period."
  - Records: bill 07e53105 is unpaid (513.44) after the grace that ended 03-30, and no late-charge fee points to it. The state does not hold.
  - Searching "late charge" / "interest bill" finds "Late Charge on an Unpaid Interest Bill": "charged once against that bill, as a fee charge with the late charge fee code pointing to the bill, on the day after the last grace day".
- Dependency direction and order: P2 → P1 → P0. P2 is an agent write, P1 the customer's write, P0 an agent write.
- No hop was pre-solved. No document named another problem's tool, a route or a chain. Each depended-on document was reached through the words of the sentence and the records ("AutoDraft enrolled", "late charge", "interest bill", `fee_code`).

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the advance". The baseline gives 10,000 (phone limit); with factors but the current 7.22 rate it gives 6,921.84. Either is excluded by S1, because the records show AutoDraft cancelled after returned payments, so the advance "is not fixed until the line's records show AutoDraft enrolled again". Enrolling without the late charge is excluded by S2. It would also give a different rate (7.158).
- Closest alternative object for the late charge: the older 2025 bills. Excluded by "assessed on the line's interest bill with the latest due date … an older bill still unpaid at that point carries no further late charge". All older bills are paid anyway.
- Alternative rate base date: the 2026-04-30 base rate change is in the future; today takes 7.250.
- Alternative advance cap: the member's 30,000 is above both the computed figure and the 10,000 phone limit, so the smaller figure governs ("you will take whatever the line allows").
- Alternative "first booked" anchor: `opened_date` 2020-03-02 versus `last_renewed_date`. "The first booking date is the booking date recorded on the line; a renewal does not change it" excludes the renewal date. The renewal date is the "start of the current term" for the season share.
- Calculation fall-backs, written down: late charge 25.67; enrolment rate 6.775; advance 10,000.00. All are definite and differ from the answers.
- Factor findability: every factor was reached from record words.
  - `return_reason 'nsf'` led to the late-charge-base doc.
  - Late-charge `fee_code` history led to the percentage and AutoDraft-discount docs.
  - `FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage` status, accrued interest and principal_balance led to the land-standing and relationship-scaling docs.
  - `opened_date` led to tenure and taper. `beginning_farmer True` on the crop-year policy led to the taper.
  - `Country Home 30-Year Fixed` autopay led to the Country Home discount.
  - `Used Equipment Loan` `deferred`/autopay/deferrals_used led to the equipment discount and the deferral share.
  - `Class B Voting Stock` issued_date led to membership tenure.
  - `Revenue Protection 70% Coverage` assigned to the line led to the crop-cover share.
  - `last_renewed_date` led to the season share.
  - Returned payment entries led to the hold share and the interest reserve. Unpaid billed interest led to the past-due reserve.
  - No computation document hinted at a variation.
